action_inputs.description: SCC profile id, such as MAC-1_Classified. Empty uses the Windows default profile of the Compliance settings page.
action_inputs.label: Profile
action_inputs.name: profile

action_inputs.description: How long provisioning may wait for all of the job's scans together; a scan still running then is cancelled and the servers left are skipped. Empty uses 45.
action_inputs.label: Maximum wait (minutes)
action_inputs.name: max_wait_minutes

description: Installs DISA SCC on each new Windows server and runs a first scan with the Compliance UI extension, so a report is on the server's Compliance tab when provisioning completes.
name: Install SCC and Run First Scan (Windows)
